A '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]]<ref name="LP" /> happened in [[3629 BBY]]<ref name="Year" /> as the [[Zakuulan Forward Recon]] of the former [[Eternal Empire]], led by [[Commander/Legends|Battalion Commander]] [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]], sought to rebuild a new and improved [[Star Fortress]]. The [[Eternal Alliance]] discovered this and landed on the world and defeated Tassar's forces.<ref name="LP" />
